_comment: Roster of the sites the /all-sites skill and the site-worker agent operate on. Keep this file identical across all three repos.

notes: The site lives one level down, in guffee-website/ — the repo root holds nothing else. Paths inside index.html are relative to that subdirectory, not to the repo root.
Single-page static site. No build step, no package.json, no test suite.
Everything is FLAT at the repo root — there is no assets/ directory on disk.

The README documents an assets/img, assets/fonts, assets/js layout that does not exist. Trust the filesystem, not the README. If you reorganize into assets/, you must update every reference in index.html and fix the README in the same commit.
Single-page static site. No build step, no package.json, no test suite.
SCAFFOLD ONLY — there is no site yet. The repo contains README.md, env.example, and gitignore.
env.example and gitignore are missing their leading dots (they are not .env.example / .gitignore and therefore are not doing their job).
The README describes an intended src/ + public/ + scripts/ layout and an npm dev/build/preview/lint workflow. None of it exists yet — treat the README as a spec, not a description.
Content-shaped tasks may have nothing to edit here. Say so plainly rather than inventing a site to edit.
Project specification figures (built-up area, height limits, garden/road allocation) are regulatory and commercial commitments. Never invent, round, or adjust them.
